sources.title: Get started with Claude in Chrome
Use Claude in Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

folds.text: Claude is not one app. It shows up in many places, and one account works across them. Right now: {{facts.apps}}.
**Web, desktop and mobile** are the everyday chat. Start here. The phone app is handy for quick questions and talking out loud.
**Claude Code** is for working on code, and **Cowork** takes bigger tasks with many steps. The desktop app gives them the most reach into your own files.
**Chrome, Excel, PowerPoint and Google Workspace** put Claude beside the page or file you already have open, so you do not copy and paste.

folds.prompt: Which app fits the job? Tap the basket.

items.text: Ask a quick question while out walking
items.why: The phone app is made for on-the-go chat.
